nom: PEACH & LILY Overnight Star Night Cream

avis.texte: I got this as a Christmas gift and fell in love with this. I have extremely acne prone skin and I didn't break out once. I use this on my off days when I don't want to do too much with my skincare and it works beautifully. wake up in the morning looking great. Its hydrating without feeling greasy. Just know that there is a slight fragrance, so if you are sensitive to that sort of thing, this isn't for you.

I am in my mid 30s and started to see that I was waking up with fine lines being more visible!!! This product has given me my confidence back every morning!!!! I wake up looking fresh and young again!!!
I practice skin cycling and this is my go to on rest days. It's also amazing for calming my redness-prone skin. I keep it in the fridge for extra calming. Highly recommended.

I do not like to dip my fingers into a jar so I use a plastic applicator to grab some of this blue product. It comes out in a chunk, like hardened putty. I don't know if the product works as stated because I just started using it. The consistency is very off-putting. P&L should warn consumers on the packaging so people know what to expect. The buyer can't make an informed decision, especially if they are expecting a cream.
This is the only moisturizer I've tried recently that I don't need a huge amount to keep my skin hydrated overnight. Keeps my skin clear too. I never wake up with bumps with this.
I love using this moisturizer and it makes my skin look so bouncy in the morning. It layers well with all of my other skincare products.
I love that its is blue and the cream is very hydrating fixes that dull dry skin in the winter but i will say it can be quiet challenging with oily skin

I love using this cream every night. It makes my skin feel soooo smooth after applying, and still moisturized when I wash my face the next morning. I usually put on moisturizer first, to feel extra smooth, as I have dry skin. But when I run out of moisturizer before the next refill arrives, this saves the night!

avis.titre: Really great if you have very very dry skin!
avis.texte: This product is deeply hydrating. I used to have these dry patches on my nose that drove me crazy, but the overnight star cream fixed those patches right up! I will say for me personally it was a bit too intense for my more oily areas like my forehead, but if you are looking for a deeply norishing and sensitive skin friendly moisturizer this is a great option.
Sick of spending so much money on night creams that are ok. This is the best moisturizer especially for the price too. Good bye to the expensive creams!

I opened the package and the smell of lavender hit me right in the face . Its the last ingredient but its sooo strong. If you love lavender its probably great. If you don't, PASS. My fault for not reading the ingredients more closely! 😞

avis.titre: I buy this again and again. Love Love Love
avis.texte: Love this, have repurchased probably 20 times at this point. My holy grail night cream. I am 32 with oily combo/acne prone skin. Please never discontinue I will cry.

I'm 38 with very dry skin & living in a dry climate. My normal nighttime routine I used Origin's Drink Up Intensive Mask over my other serums & oils. In the winter it doesnt do the trick so I have been trying out other products. This is the 3rd cream I tried and the first night I immediately loved the texture and when I woke to find my skin soft, hydrated, and dewy I was in love. It is a thick concentrated product but doesn't feel heavy on the skin to me (mind you I am used to heavy creams and oils though). The scent was mild and reminded me of Kiehl's Midnight Recovery Cloud Cream.

avis.titre: Bright, glowing skin in the AM
avis.texte: I was surprised to see how much my skin glowed in the morning. I look younger in the morning. The ingredients in this jar are incredible!! I have never seen so many wonderful plants in one formula! I know people said it's thick or too much but, with all that goodness packed in I do not mind! The cream disappears quickly and my skin seems to drink it in. highly recommended!
Purchased this due to great reviews and like other P&L products. Unfortunately this cream leaves my skin tingling, doesn't absorb into my skin, and I dont see any improvement to my skin.
Great night cream. Very hydrating! I like to layer this over my tretinoan at night to keep my skin from drying out. My partner compliments how great my skin looks in the morning.

This replaced my previous night cream (farmacy honey halo). I love both, but this moisturizer is sooo hydrating and a little goes a long way. I really appreciate the explanation of the ingredients on the bottle as well. I found this was super soothing, thick and hydrating without being too much, and it did not bother my eczema.
Provides intense, long-lasting moisture, I wake up to hydrated, dewy, and plump skin. When I wash my face in the morning after I still feel a layer of the product on my skin.

Personally I didnt like it. Its extremely thick to the point that I got an expired product. When rubbing it into my face I can feel the oil sitting on my face. It didnt absorb well and I had a couple pimples pop up the next day so I wouldnt say this is safe for acne prone skin.
I'm glad that I have this mask in my nightstand for those nights when winter really kills my skin and moisturizer just isn't enough for my chapped skin.

avis.titre: The overnighter I have been looking for!
avis.texte: This is exactly the product I was looking for! It is super thick and custard-like so it makes a perfect overnight cream. I could imagine the texture would be a drawback for some if they are looking for something that's lighter and soaks in. There is a cooling sensation that is very satisfying after retinol application. Since it's pigmented, it does force me to remember to wash my face first thing in the morning (I wake up a little green with this and the yellow retinol) which I don't have a good habit of but appreciate. I could see this as a negative for some but it works for me!
Improvements in just one night. Im amazed! I will continue this prducts for ever :) so greatful i found this brand. My whole skincare routine is peach and lily
All Peach and Lily products are amazing! I had issues with my complexion and since using their products I have had no issues.
I wish I had taken care of skin years ago but the Over Night Cream is so moistening!

I literally cannot be without Overnight Star. It's magic in a jar!! I wake up to smooth, plump, glowing skin every morning. It's a very generous size jar and a little goes a long way. Very worth the price!!

I tried this initially because I have a generally favorable opinion of Peach & Lily. I keep a list of the skin care products I want to use 'for the duration' and Overnight Star Night Cream is now on the list. In fact, I like it so much I risked buying it as a holiday gift for my sister, who tends to reject gifts 'cause she doesn't want more, 'things'. She kept this one, and I believe the reason is that I told her how soothing it is. She recently suffered a facial injury and while she recovers, she's stopped using actives like retinol. She needs comfort, and I expect Overnight Star to give her that. It def gives my own face comfort. I love the texture, and I'm concerned that some peeps here are saying it's waxy, or like putty. I wonder if they got old product, 'cause my own Overnight Star is simply creamy, and a particularly nice kind of creamy, too. I like the light scent it has, I like how it goes on and how it *stays* on (I thought it would come off all over the pillow, but no), and I love how soft my skin feels, in the morning and even beyond, if I skip the morning ritual. If I had to choose just one nighttime moisturizer, Overnight Star would be it. I'm in my 60s, with normal skin. I don't need a super heavy facial moisturizer even in winter, so maybe Overnight Star would be too light for some peeps. In the summer I use a lighter night cream.
Love this overnight cream. Leaves my skin so hydrated and refreshed. Love how my skin feels in the morning. This is great for your skincare routine. And the aroma is really light. You can bank on it!
The BEST night cream. 1000/10 recommend this. I've never used a specific moisturizer for night and this is a gas changer. My skin has never been so hydrated and soft.
I've been using this for a few years now and have tried other moisturizers. I find myself coming back to this time and time again. It goes on like butter.
smells nice, no itching, really highly concentrated, so good quality and you feel the hydration a lot, banks are very smooth indeed and firm

As someone with acne-prone skin who uses a nightly prescription retinol, I have always struggled with redness, dryness, and the worst unsightly skin flaking/peeling during the dry winter months. Then I found this product, and WOW has it been a game changer for me! The peeling has virtually disappeared, the redness has improved, and my skin looks hydrated and smooth when I wake up. All of this without triggering any break-outs! I love the thick texture and the lavender scent. A little really does go a long way- I apply all over my face and neck every night and I probably use about a third of the jar a month. This is totally a winter holy grail product for me now!

I really wanted to like this product, but it didn't work for me at all. After a couple of uses, it made my skin feel a little burning and uncomfortable. It also dried out my skin so much that it started to flake, and I even broke out with acne afterward. I stopped using it because the irritation wasn't worth it. Definitely not repurchasing.

avis.titre: I love this night cream and am a repeat buyer,
avis.texte: I live in a dry desert climate that ages skin quickly, This overnight cream feels very clean on my skin, moisturizes deeply and leaves no residue. In the morning, my skin feels soft, supple, and looks healthy. I'm 77 yrs old and love this product,
I've been loving this after exfoliating my face. It's leaving my skin silky and so shiny.
I randomly decided to try this on my hands for my eczema. Three nights later it was completely gone! No rash medicine! I just use this for my face and flare ups!

This product is literal magic. . I bought this wanting to give myself a fresh start with something new and even my boyfriend loves this product. . we have both noticed a difference with our skin barriers and overall more healthy looking and feeling skin! If you're on thr edge… just get it! :relaxed:️

avis.titre: It makes my skin very sof
avis.texte: It makes my skin very soft when I wake up and it has a nice smell and texture as well. and i like the blue color of it.
Love everything about it! It's so thick but yet so lightweight. I wake up glowing & skin is butter soft! Don't finish the jar without a backup. LITTLE GOES A LONGGGG WAY!
This is a aolid heavy moisturizer but if you are prone to breakouts/clogged pores it is not for you. The texture, color and scent didn't bother me at all.
I never leave reviews but….this cream not only burns when applied, but also dried out ny skin soooooo bad. I had to return it.
Amazing Texture, amazing moisture, scent is very light, very pleasant.

Really love this cream- it's quite thick so I like to put it on a decent amount of time before I go to bed so it doesn't end up on my pillow. It's helped a lot with my breakouts/usually softens the appearance of acne or completely makes it disappear. My skin is quite sensitive but it's never reacted badly to it & does leave my skin very soft in the morning. Will be ordering another one soon!
Has been for great nighttime hydration as seasons change. Texture and look aren't the best, but maybe part of the secret sauce?
The best hydrating night cream! I wake up with soft and calm skin.
Have very dry and sensitive skin and so far this cream is perfect for me.Using for two weeks. Absorbs quickly and fees great goin on.
This product is ah-mazing! I wake up feeling hydrated without the oily feeling! My skin has never felt so soft!!

I always wait a long time to review any skincare or beauty products. Sometimes they work on my skin for a little bit, but before long I need something else. I have been using this cream since May 2024 and it has done wonders for my sensitive, red, acne prone skin. My skin always feels smooth and hydrated, but not oily. I usually take 1-2 minutes to fully massage the product into my face to avoid any residue feeling, but even when I'm being lazy, it soaks up pretty quickly. I love the way it looks and feels on my skin, and plan to use it for a long time.
My last step before bed! Love the texture and the great hydration it adds to my skin.
This is really moisturizing to my skin I really love to use this. The thickness make it last longer as well. Definitely a great buy.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it, but much too thick
avis.texte: I love many P&L products, but not this one. I thought it sounded perfect for my older, dry skin but I cannot get past the gross, thick texture. It's like weird-smelling putty, I have to scrape it out of the jar with a spatula, and it doesn't absorb well. It didn't break me out or irritate my skin but I still can't stand to use it. I prefer P&L's Peptide Moisturizer.
I have been using it for weeks now and I can tell the difference it has made. My skin feels more even and smoother!

I'm always looking for an overnight cream that isn't too greasy, as my face can get oily during the night. The texture of this cream is light, and after using it a few times, my skin looks radiant in the morning. My blemishes have also lightened. I'm happy that this cream does all the hard work while I just relax and get a good night's sleep.
Great buttery, rich feel to this cream which absorbs so well & feels great as a final layer before retiring for the night. A small amount goes a long way.
This is a great overnight lotion. It's so hydrating without being too thick.

Absolutely love this cream. I use it every night before bed and I don't feel the need to do a routine in the morning, but of course I do. My skin feels fresh and clean. Compliments to its hydrating feel and lightweight application.
This is my second order so I'm a fan. Not only do I use it at night, but also on airplane travel. The moisturizing is fantastic.

avis.titre: I like the way my skin fe
avis.texte: I like the way my skin feels in the morning. Love this product.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it but still searching
avis.texte: I haven't had good expeience with this brand before but gave a shot since its been a few years. Texture is very thick, could put the cream upside down and doesnt move. There is a slight lavendar smell if you looking for it but otherwise smells plasticy to me. Ingredients dont seem to be in high enough confentration to work much- I have sensitive dry skin and my skin begame clogged with more problems once using this product. Saw no improcement with any of the claims it had for the product unfortunately.
Love! ❤️ perfectly hydrating and a wonderful way to end my nightly routine.

Wanted to give it a try since it was on sale and based on reviews but it did me more harm then good. Woke up in the AM with a super oily face and developed a irritation/dermatitis on both cheeks . Redness and some itchiness its been going on. Expected better but will return soon, still have to try their lazy pads and see if they sont cause me the same reaction.
I've been using this a couple of times a week in place of my regular moisturizer and I love it.

First, I want to say that it doesn't leave your skin blue; it has excellent ingredients that aren't harmful to your health. It's wonderful; it moisturizes very well and leaves your face feeling wonderful.
Love the texture of it. Thick in the jar but goes on smooth and light! Super hydrating and sufficient as an overnight moisturizer

It's super thick and luxurious. It smells calming and relaxing. The blue color doesn't stick around, it turns clear when you rub it in. I get my skin was smooth after using it and it felt great and hydrated in the morning.

LOVE the scent, texture, and moisture this mask provides! If you're looking for a top-tier moisturizer that also has crazy anti-aging ingredients that work overtime, do not sleep on this. Bonus points if you have dry skin!
Love using this at night as my final step in my skin care!! I wake up feeling so refreshed and hydrated. A little goes a long way so you totally get your moneys worth too.
It has a light lavender scent. I love how silky my skin feels after using this.
I absolutely love this cream. The best night cream I've ever used, without question!

I have been using the overnight star night cream for about 2 weeks. It is very thick and rich, and it feels very hydrating going on. The lavender scent is a strong for those sensitive to scent. The smoothing effect of the cream feels almost like a residue that can be washed off. . . It's still too soon to tell if I love this cream or not.

I love peach and lily! But this product did not help my skin at all. I have dehydrated oily sensitive skin and this night cream felt very oily on my face and not moisturizing. My face would burn, turn red, and cause breakouts. There was also a strong fragrance to the product. I tried using it for my elbows and knees, but it caused a lot of rashes/reactions.

I love this cream! Over time I've noticed that my acne scars have faded while using this cream consistently, but also its moisturizing and smoothing and my skin both looks and feels nice after using it. A little goes a long way. 4 stars because it's a bit pricey
This is a great night cream that leaves my skin super moisturized and bright for the next morning!
My skin feels like it got a huge drink of water overnight and is smooth as silk.
Gorgeous texture and soaks straight into the skin, the perfect overnight cream. Wake up with beautiful, soft, moisturized skin.

avis.titre: Sensitive skin reaction to this one
avis.texte: I love all of Peach and Lily's products that I've tried, except this. It's triggering an eczema- like reaction to the skin near my eyes. I've tried to use it only on cheeks and forehead, yet I still have the same reaction. It's a shame, I liked the idea of this one.

I used this all winter as the last step in my nighttime skincare routine and loved it! I loved the rich texture and never had any issues with breakouts. I use the P&L retinol and lactic acid (alternating nights), and if I don't have a good moisturizer I will dry out from the retinol. Highly recommend!
My go to night cream. Really makes my complexion and skin look really good in the morning.
I use this every night before bed and notice results immediately. It's great waking up with a hydrated, ready to go, face:)
Smooth and easy application for hydrating your skin overnight
This burns my skin at times but my skin is super sensitive . It does make my skin very soft and I use it several times a week!

I wanted to elevate my evening routine with something that would help with my dark spots, and over the course of a few weeks, I have definitely noticed a lot of my dark spots fading. I have some issues with skin-picking which leaves some pretty bad dark spots, but I feel like this cream has helped a lot with those. Great evening moisturizer, I use the matcha pudding during the day! Right now I use it every day, but I think maybe in the future I'll go down to 3-4 nights a week.

avis.titre: irritated skin and broke me out
avis.texte: i really thought this was gonna be a winner for me, but every time ive used it my skin feels like its burning slightly and i always wake up with breakouts the next day. oh well :(
I really wanted to love this, but every time I've tried to use it I end up breaking out. It seems great for some people but I don't know why my skin doesn't like it.

Skincare is a journey, and sometimes that journey leads you to discover what not to put on your skin. I think my skin did not like the acai berry extract in this product, as the product broke me out frequently. I have since gone back to a favorite moisturizer. Some comments mention a dislike for the feel and fragrance of the product. I had no issues with either of these. I really liked the feel of the product on my skin, and I found the fragrance pleasant.
Excellent night cream. Skin is bouncy and hydrated in the morning. I have combination skin and did not experience any breakouts. I use this nightly all seasons except summer time. I highly recommend!

Wow! Peach and Lily you have outdone yourself yet again! This is the dreamiest creamiest blend of bliss for my skin at night I wake up feeling so soft and hydrated and it smells divine!!! Like being in the spa! Love the beautiful blue color that disappears once you apply it's absolutely fabulous! Would recommend highly 10/10 🩵🩵🩵🩵

This is one of the best moisturizers I have ever used! I have combination, sensitive, acne prone skin which gets dry after I use my prescription retinoid. Overnight Star helps prevent my skin peeling from dryness in the wintertime, and keeps it hydrated and soothed in summertime. I appreciate that the packaging is glass and recyclable/reusable. There is no blue cast when I put this moisturizer on, but I use it at night so it wouldn't matter to me if there was. I will buy this until I die & I wish they made a jumbo/value size.

I've been a P&L addict for years and have only now discovered how amazing this night cream is. Deeply moisturizing with a very smooth texture; like butter cream without any tackiness. Has a very pleasant, light lavender smell that compliments my nighttime routine. Will definitely be purchasing again.

I was really excited about this but find that my skin is drier than ever since starting it. I might just be adjusting and will still see it through and finish the full tub, but I haven't been amazed with it.

I cannot say enough good things about this product. Before I bought it, I kind of thought overnight creams were a scam, were they not the same as regular moisturizer. I decided to try it once just to see and it is literally the only product I have ever used where I noticed a difference IMMEDIATELY, I'm talking the next morning. When I use this, I feel like I don't even need to do skincare again in the morning because it locks everything in so well. BUY THIS, you won't regret it.
My face broke out after several use. I kept using it since it was pricy and thought it would go away but it didnt. I stopped using it. Not sure why.

This cream has been wonderful for my dry, sensitive skin. I usually try and buy unscented, but there is the slightest scent which I find really refreshing and clean, and it hasn't bothered my skin at all. This has been a lovely part of my nighttime skin routine and I wake up still feeling moisturized. I do feel like it absorbs quickly and while it's definitely a great hydrator, it's light enough that I have used it during the day when I ran out of my normal day cream. Love love love it.

I have been using the Overnight Star Night Cream for years, and it is my favorite final step in my skincare routine. It's super hydrating and has a plush, thick texture, and I can use very little of it to achieve the results I want without any greasiness or heaviness on my skin. The mild lavender scent is very soothing and gets my mind and body in the right state to start unwinding. I use the Overnight Star on its own at the end of my day and my skin always feels very soft and hydrated in the morning. I truly don't see myself using any other nighttime product because it's just so hard to beat.

Love this! Wonderful on my very sensitive skin. It's made a big difference in the dry patches on my combo skin. Using this at night plus the glass skin serum (which I use morning and night), with the matcha pudding being my morning moisturizer. Planning to incorporate the lactic acid serum a few nights a week as well!

I love using this overnight cream!! It has been my go to for over the past 3 years now. I really enjoy waking up with refreshed looking skin and this cream definitely delivers. While I get my beauty sleep this cream is still working through the night.
I used to scream every night over my serum and moisturizer cream or I use it by itself. I'm asking feel really soft and nice in the morning.
Such an easy way to wake up in the morning with moisturized and glowy skin. Has a nice thickness too it without being too heavy. Also such a cute color.

This is key in my nighttime skin routine. I like to go in with some heavy exfoliants and using this has always kept my moisture barrier intact. It's superrr moisturizing and helps so much with dryness in the winter time. Have gone through several of these and it's by far my favorite night cream.

I have been using this nightly for a few years and my facial skin feels plump and soft. It's soothing and evens my skin tone. Because it's been so effective I have started using it before I go on my walks and after I spend any time in the sun and/or wind.

You don't realize how effective this night cream is until after a few nights. . . and then, it truly feels firmer, more even, and very hydrated. I take out some and then rub it lightly on my finger tips to cream it up . . . . slide it all over my face and ears and neck. Amazing.

avis.titre: Best intensive moisturizer I've found. Love it!
avis.texte: I'm 70 years old. I have always taken great care of my skin and it shows. The winter cold and wind these past two winters have made me long for a more effective moisturizer. After trying more than 8 different products, I finally found one that works - and works on a deeper level than all the others. Peaches and Lily, thank you! After using the Overnight Star cream, the texture, bounce, and glow of my skin have all improved. I use it day and night - though, if your skin is younger, you may want to stick to nightime only. The formula is thick and rich but feels very light. It is not greasy and absorbs readily. A dab the size of my little fingernail is enough for both face and neck. It feels silky and is perfect under my primer. Finally!! A moisturizer that truly improves my skin!
I love this so far! It's so refreshing putting it on at night. It's a great lather. I can still feel the hydrating effects of it when I wake up - which is great in my very dry house in the winter.
My granddaughter recommended this nighttime moisturizer and I love it! Clean ingredients, very creamy. Leaves my skin very soft. It's a thick cream but it doesn't feel that way on my skin.

I've never found something that actually hydrates my skin and keeps it hydrated all night long. I have terrible psoriasis and this cream has been a life saver. Honestly I'm not sure what I would do if they ever stopped making it.

Okay, I'm 69 with ultra-sensitive rosacea skin and eyes. Trying new products is always risky, to say the least. In need of a richer night cream, and often able to tolerate Peach & Lily products, I decided to give this a try… and boy, am I glad I did! This cream is extraordinary. Truly, it feels like I'm transported to a luxury spa to open, view, and apply this cream. And my skin drinks it in and loves it! Thank you, P&L for doing it again!

I agree woth most people saying it absorbs quickly into the skin, but this product has a lavendar fragrance that really takes away from the experience. I wouldnt say my skin is bery sensitive, but I can feel my skin is slighly irritated whenever I put this on. Overall I was expecting a lot more for the price point. It feels more and more like a product for children between the smell and the blue tinted hue it leaves over your face.

avis.titre: Nice but strong smell and stings
avis.texte: I like the feel of this cream but like the title it stings a little but that could be of my dry skin as well. It has a strong smell too but it isn't bad
I love this so much but sometimes it gives me a weird texture in the morning I never know if I should wash it pfff or keep it on and do my morning skin routine but it's honestly a really good product
I am in love with this product. Soothing lavender scent which is great for bedtime. My skin is glowing when i wake up. Winter leaves me dry and itchy, this product knocks it out of the park
Since I have been using the product line my skin is not dry and it has gotten softer.
I love how this layers on my other products, feels like it holds in hydration. Thick and lovely!
I'm loving this product. It's a little thicker than day moisturizers and it the morning my face feels so soft and smooth.
Very moisturizing and a lovely smell! But for those who need lots of moisture I think the Matcha pudding is slightly better

I have struggled with dry skin for years. I started using moisturizer each night as part of my routine, and almost immediately saw a change. My skin looks refreshed in the morning. The cream has a relaxing scent, helping me unwind after a long day. I highly recommend this!

avis.titre: Added to my P & L routinr
avis.texte: Tried P & L with the starter kit. Liked all the products so wanted to add the night cream. It's light, not greasy, absorbs quickly, feels comfortable, has a very delicate scent. Skin feels moisturized and refreshed. A little dab goes a long way.
The texture of this product is very creamy and heavy definitely for nighttime wear. I do think it helped with moisturizing but I still have peeling skin if I don't use an exfoliant weekly.

I do not have sensitive skin and the first time I used this it burned so bad and turned my whole face red. I researched and saw some stinging is normal, I used a serum but maybe I didn't use enough. Will try to use more serum and try again.
This is my favorite cream of all times. So rich, thick and soaks into my skin so well. My skin feels so soft and plum.
So soft and smells great! I think it's done a great job at minimizing acne on my face and smoothing my skin in general. I use it with the snail toner and it's been awesome.

The previous brand I was using discontinued my usual night cream and I was so disappointed, until I found Peach & Lilly's Overnight Star Night Cream. I am so impressed and I'm glad my previous cream was discontinued because it lead me to this! I truly noticed a difference in the look and feel of my skin after only a few nights.
Is very moisturizing and help my skin in this cold weather. The quality feels super light but moisturizing at the same time you don't need a lot of product just a little.
Not much to say. It's a moisturizer. I can't say anything "magical" is happening but I have had no issues with it either.
This cream is on the thicker side when applying so I recommend using less and adding more as you need it. It had a subtle lavender scent that I love so extra points for that!
I absolutely love this night cream! It has proven effective ingredients and keeps my skin moisturized through the night!

avis.titre: Just 2 Weeks and All I Wear is a Tinted Moisturizer
avis.texte: I bought this alongside the Glass Skin started kit and the combination has been such a game changer for my skin! I have sensitive, dry skin and have tried so many skin care lines and within just two weeks Peach & Lily has completely turned my skin around. I've gone from wearing full coverage foundation to a tinted moisturizer - in just two weeks! Seriously, if you've been searching for a skin care line, take a chance on Peach & Lily.
Leaves my skin super hydrated and soft! I have acne prone skin so any kind of moisturizer usually makes me break out. I was sooo surprised this didn't and left my skin so much softer!

As someone who uses a retinoid, I need a heavy duty moisturizer. This does not cut it. I wake up with dry skin that gets more parched throughout the day. I have to layer this with other sleeping masks, which defeats it's purpose. Hard pass.

I use this every single night as my nightly moisturizer and I love it! It is a nice thick cream and it in the morning, your face will feel soo smooth! Honestly, I felt the results after my 1st use. I am half way done with the jar and that tells alot if you knew me. I change out my moisturizer and have been doing that for years but I can't stop using this! I would try to use a different one to change things up but then I go right back to this one the next day. Little goes a long way so you don't need much. I put a quarter size of a penny on the 4 major parts of the face ( forehead, both cheeks, and chin ) and that is plenty! So the jar will last you for awhile even if you use it like I do. Anyway, if you are thinking about this, don't anyone and add it to your cart and get it and u will thank me later! Trust me, you will thank me later! Yes, the price is a bit high compared to other moisturizers but this isn't like other moisturizers. This is actually a Korean brand and I LOVE using Korean skincare cause I honestly think they are the best and also, ingredient wise, the best for your skin.

I've been trying to use the is stuff as a last layer before bedtime. It absorbs well, but I would say my face seems super hydrated in the morning. I feel like the Lagom Cellus Aqualane drops do a much better job than this stuff - this felt like a bit of a waste.

Overnight Star Night Cream is a must have addition to my nighttime routine. With aging dry skin. I'm always looking for a moisturizer that lasts through the night so that I wake with smooth supple skin. This moisturizer is non-greasy, non-sticky and delivers what it boasts.
This is a go-to for me! Non-greasy, feels wonderful, and keeps me hydrated overnight. I love the texture and smell.
I've been using this in the evenings when I don't use Tretinoin. When I wake up in the morning my skin is glowy and plump. Love this moisturizer!

It took me almost a year to appreciate this cream (this is the case with many products). When I realized how good it was, it was over :) So maybe you need to give it time to prove itself and accumulate the effect. It's a real find - while you sleep it makes your skin healthy, pink and rested. The main thing is not to apply too much or you risk getting a puffy face in the morning, a thin layer is enough for beauty in the morning.

avis.titre: Not as moisturizing as I had expected
avis.texte: I had been wanting to try this as a night cream for a while and decided to go for it this winter. It has a nice texture and slight scent. While my face feels smooth in the morning, it is not as hydrating as I need it to be. Will use this up but will not reorder.

I pair this with a daily face moisturizer and use it mostly on my neck and chest. I use it when I need extra moisture on my face as well, but it is a little heavy for me to use there even overnight. I enjoy it more when giving my neck and chest a little extra care at night. Good product and smells nice.

avis.titre: Ok product but not at this price point
avis.texte: This has lavender (strong scent) which can be very irritating to the skin. It is an ok moisturizer but did not give me any brightening effect.

If I could convince you to try one out of all the putty type things this is it. I could use it after every face wash but I keep it to the night routine because I enjoy the matcha one in morning. Very gentle. Very calming.
This stuff has been a huge help this winter!! Idk why I waited so long to try it.

I am in love with this nightcream. Smells amazing (lavender), is rich and buttery, and is hydration heaven. After just one use my skin looked way more dewy and hydrated. This is my new go to night cream.
This moisturizer is my favorite to use every night before bed as the last step in my bedtime skin routine. I wake up with soft glowy skin! What's not to love?!
Star night cream is the best I've ever used! During winter, I use it daytime to keep my skin moisturized. It is not heavy, goes on silky and is not greasy! Love it
This feels lovely on your face. Its hydrating without being greasy and my face feels amazing the next day.
Love this cream! It's nice and creamy, goes on smoothly and feels so luxurious. Wonderful moisturizer for your skin to soak in while you sleep! I use it religiously every night!
This is a must have for my night routine. My skin looks hydrated and glowy when I place this on before bed. I have started using it on my hands also (they have gotten very dry this winter!).

avis.titre: Best night cream I've ever used.
avis.texte: LOVE LOVE LOVE this cream. I use it every night and am waking up every morning with hydrated and smooth skin. Best night cream I've ever used.

I absolutely LOVE my Peach and Lily skin care. I have gotten so many compliments on my skin. I am 59 yrs old and been using for 3 months and LOVE IT. Huge difference. My sister got mad because my skin looks so good and she is 64 !! Now she is using it

It takes very little of this to moisture and hydrate face, neck, and chest. Just get the tiniest little bit, rub it in your hands to melt it really well, and apply in upward strokes. My skin is oily, sensitive, and lightly aging. This moisturizer has worked with several different serums and treatments, and has never given me problems. I've been using for six months, and I've only used HALF the jar. Worth every penny.

I finally made the jump to buy this cream but deeply regret it. It breaks me out and doesnt give me the morning glow other people rave about. The aquaphor ointment or cerave ointment are cheaper and better alternatives to this product.
My favorite item out of the bundle I purchased. It doesn't leave my skin sticky or ruins my pillow case.
This is my 2nd favorite p&l product (the hydrating cleanser is the first). I use this every night and it feels so good going on and keeps my dehydrated skin feeling good in the winter.
I recommend this product. My skin is so dry and very sensitive. Using this product, to be honest I did not have to rinse my face in the morning.
I use it every night after my face wash routine. It makes my face feel smooth, soft, and hydrated after every use. The softness remains in the morning and I will continue to use this product forever!
Love this product. Great night cream that is not greasy but so moisturizing.

I love wearing this night cream. I feel so hydrated in the morning. It's a nice thick cream yet doesn't clog my pores. I'd recommend if you want a great quality moisturizer to alternate with other moisturizers at night. Thank you!
Creamy and melts into skin. My skin gets dry in the winter and this has been a great addition to my night skincare routine. It's think but also melts into my skin and doesn't feel heavy.

Okay, so it does have a strange texture so i was iffy at first. I needed to switch out my night cream because my skin becomes immune to products but i would totally buy this again. My skin never felt more hydrated before. I was in love the it cosmetics night cream but this one is my new favorite. Much better ingredients if you dont like harsh chemicals. 10/10 product. Never received more compliments on my skin.
This cream is thick and smells amazing! As someone whose skin hates any sort of fragrance/scent this pasta the sensitive skin test:) makes my skin feel and look healthier and hydrated. Love it!
My skin has never felt more moisturized and smooth than when I use this. Also I love the fun color
This night cis as soft as butter but definitely not as greasy! My skin felt replenished the next morning. The cream also smells nice and refreshing.

I started using this last fall at night when it's chilly and love that my face isn't dry in the morning! I stocked up for this fall/winter/early spring with a few jars so me and my skin are ready to go until it's warmer again! Great product, P&L :) Please keep this one around!
Nice thick moisturizer that lasts. Soaks up nicely in your skin. Woke up with baby soft skin.

I've had some type of eczema (?) on my upper eye and eyelid for the last few years. It always shows up during winter. It looks like red elephant skin, it burns and sheds. Sounds terrible right? It sucks. I put this cream on there and it calmed it down. It's the first cream that's ever done anything noticeable and I've tried everything. It burned when i put it on, like literally everything else does, but the next day the skin was so calm comparatively. If it keeps it up (which is has) then this is what I'll use as long as they make it. For those who just have dry skin, which I do too, it's also really nice on the rest of my face.
great moisturizer for night it feels light and skin feels great the next day

I have been using this product for 4 months now and it's given me glass skin without an oily feeling, it's fragrance free which is perfect for anyone with sensitive skin. I love it and will be repurchasing!

avis.titre: Perfect Winter Overnight Mask – Wake Up to Plump, Hydrated S
avis.texte: This is an amazing overnight mask! It leaves my skin feeling plump, hydrated, and refreshed by morning. You only need a thin layer before bed, making it super easy to use without feeling heavy. It's especially ideal for winter when my skin tends to get drier, and it provides that deep moisture my skin craves. While it feels a bit oily upon application, it absorbs beautifully overnight, so you wake up with a smooth, nourished complexion. This has quickly become my go-to for keeping my skin moisturized and healthy-looking in the colder months!
I love it! I even think the light fragrance helps me sleep better.
See a difference in my skin smoothness, moisture and reduction of wrinkels
My favorite perfect night cream for a fresh clean look and feel. Moisturizer than really softens my skin and helps with blemishes.
So far I've been happy with this Night Cream. I've only used it a few weeks so I haven't noticed a difference in skin appearance but I like the way it absorbs, feels and smells.

I have sensitive acne prone skin that tends to get dry in the winter months. After using my skin would break out for a few days after use. It's it worth it for me. Acne is a struggle and there maybe another product out there that has the same benefits but without the breakouts.

I am absolutely obsessed with this night cream. An absolute must-add to your nightly routine. The texture has a thickness that you can feel melt into your skin. So many compliments when I'm wearing no makeup!
